title-hall: Use the existing logo and menu icons. Quit is desktop-only. All six cultures appear in the reference; the production hall is quieter behind live controls.
new-game: Four real modes, with illustrated placeholder descriptions. Use catalog-driven campaign copy. Local hotseat is supported; do not infer network multiplayer from 'a friend'.
campaign: Generated chapter names and the shown four-mission sequence are placeholders, not actual campaign lore/count. Use the selected campaign's missionIds and existing cover. The outline is read-only; no replay or selectable mission nodes.
skirmish: Illustrated map names, sizes and victory text are placeholders. Use actual authored-map paintings and catalog facts; do not create these sample maps or introduce new victory conditions.
random-map: Use the nine separate production thumbnails, exact mapgen IDs and actual summaries. Landscape illustrations are not precise generated-map previews. The interactive reference demonstrates valid size/count states and preserved chapter selections.
empire-setup: The painting illustrates four seats, not a fixed requirement. Current AI difficulty is one match-wide setting, not separate per-AI difficulty as the illustration suggests. Use real allowed patron portraits, actual map title and map-defined seat count. Map switching stays on the preceding selection screen.
encyclopedia: Eight categories and six factions plus Neutral are represented. Creature names/order/tier numerals and forms are illustrative; bind actual catalog families and upgrades. Keep Peltast and every other family at its real tier. Other categories have distinct data layouts.
creature-detail: Replace the static generated griffin with the existing animated sprite viewer. Stats, lore, costs, growth and animation choices come from catalog/requiredAnimations. Base/upgraded forms are explicit controls. Blank numeric values in this reference are not a proposed data omission.
settings: Audio is the representative page. Preserve all seven sections and every existing field, including graphics quality, adaptive resolution and FPS. Test Sound is a button, not a persisted checkbox. Live percentages and controls remain HTML.
save-archive: Save names, dates and hero names are sample composition only. Retain Save/Load tabs, with Save unavailable without a session, even though the painting emphasizes Load. MissionThumb is mission illustration, not a captured save screenshot. Preserve exact slot counts and compatibility states.
map-library: Names, dimensions, thumbnails and the example '8 empires' are non-authoritative mockup content; current maps support the actual schema limits (at most six). No new map preview generation is required. Use generic art unless a real suitable preview exists. Templates copy into local documents.
map-editor: Use actual Map/Empires/Site/Check fields and preserve every tool. The terrain painting is a layout reference; retain the real editor canvas and map document. All validation and tool behavior remain code-driven.
hall-of-records: All records, dates and scores are fictional examples. Use local platform.records and actual columns. No online leaderboard or fabricated entries. A title-menu Records link is optional new navigation to the existing screen.
shared-dialog: Use this hierarchy for existing confirmations. Discard confirmation belongs over Settings or another real dirty editor, never over a read-only encyclopedia. Safe initial focus is Keep editing. No painted button is an interactive control.
